notes:
Settings, Automation and Alert Rules have a cleaner layout - each setting on its own row with a line saying what it does, and every change saves on its own (no Save buttons).

Import bots now sits right beside Add Bot, so bringing your accounts across from Director or Botfather is easy to find.

Excalibur was removed from Items: a bot can only use it on heroes in the city running its autorun. Penicillin is unchanged.
